description.value:
A creature you can see within 90 feet flickers into a holographic afterimage and collapses. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (it may choose to fail) or be teleported to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range, provided that space is on a surface or in a liquid able to support it without squeezing.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 3rd level or higher, the power's range increases by 30 feet for each slot level beyond 2nd.
